description: Rick Beato's videos primarily revolve around in-depth music analysis and education, where he uses his professional background to break down the composition, production techniques, and music theory behind famous songs (such as his "What Makes This Song Great?" series). Another major category consists of long-form interviews with legendary musicians and producers (such as Sting and Brian May), exploring their creative processes and career experiences. He also frequently shares critical commentary on the current state of the music industry, contemporary music trends, and the impact of AI on music creation.
